title: Affine chart recovery from normalized tensor coordinates
statement: Let A,B,C be commutative rings, r:A → B, r₁:B → C, r₀:A → C, and q:Y → X, p:Z → Y, q₀:Z → X with p ≫ q = q₀. Let U be an open cover of X, a a chart, and M,N modules on U(a) with M quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], [def-pc-scheme], [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let P,Q be A-modules, δM:P ≃ Γ(M), δN:Q ≃ Γ(N). Put Wₓ=U.pullback₁ q, W₀=U.pullback₁ q₀ and V=Wₓ.pullback₁ p, with l:V(a) → Wₓ(a), v:V(a) → W₀(a) the canonical maps. Assume Wₓ(a) affine. Suppose maps ρₓ:B → Γ(Wₓ(a)), ρ₀:C → Γ(W₀(a)) and additive equivalences eₓM,eₓN,e₀M,e₀N identify scalar extensions of P,Q with sections of the respective pullbacks. Require semilinearity of eₓM,eₓN along ρₓ and of e₀N along ρ₀, and all four unit normalizations e(1 ⊗ m)=pullbackΓ(δ(m)). Assume v.appTop(ρ₀(r₁(b)))=l.appTop(ρₓ(b)). Let cQ:C ⊗ₐ Q ≅ C ⊗ᵦ (B ⊗ₐ Q) be C-linear and satisfy cQ(1 ⊗ n)=1 ⊗ (1 ⊗ n). Given module morphisms τ:C ⊗ₐ P → C ⊗ₐ Q and s:B ⊗ₐ P → B ⊗ₐ Q with τ(1 ⊗ m)=cQ⁻¹(1 ⊗ s(1 ⊗ m)), and sheaf morphisms ψ on W₀(a), s′ on Wₓ(a) with ψ(e₀M(z))=e₀N(τ(z)) and s′(eₓM(z))=eₓN(s(z)) for every z, then chartOrdinaryMapRecovery q p q₀ w U a M N ψ s′ holds [def-pc-chart-ordinary-map-recovery]. This assertion has no inverse-system or colimit hypotheses and constructs no Hom equivalence.

proof.text: The pullback composition comparison d sends the direct composite unit to the iterated unit by pullbackCompOfEq_hom_app_pullbackΓ and its inverse. For Q compare z ↦ d.hom(pullbackΓ v(e₀N(cQ.inv(1 ⊗ z)))) and z ↦ pullbackΓ l(eₓN(z)). On 1 ⊗ n they agree by cQ normalization and the unit comparison. Semilinearity and the ring-map equation extend this to b ⊗ n, and tensor induction handles every z. This calculation is proved in Lean, including the tensor scalar law, the inverse-cQ normalization and the square-unit comparison.

Use the affine pullback Hom extensionality lemma: apply the pullback adjunction Hom equivalence and global-section extensionality on the affine source X₁, proved by restriction along its spectrum isomorphism and hom_ext_of_isQuasicoherent_Spec. Pullback of M is quasi-coherent. On stage generators eₓM(1 ⊗ m), the input unit comparison, hψ, hτ, the Q-coordinate identity, and hs give equality. This is written as a calc of seven section equalities by congrArg and transitivity. Semilinearity and tensor induction extend to all stage tensors; surjectivity of eₓM gives all stage global sections, hence equality of the sheaf maps. No affine hypothesis on V or X₀ is needed.

The chart assertion is the specialization of the square criterion to the canonical lift v from V(a) to W₀(a), with l its stage projection. pullback.lift_snd gives the square equation; unfold chartOrdinaryMapRecovery once and apply the proved generic criterion. The global-section extensionality proof restricts to Spec Γ(X₁) and uses only affine tilde reconstruction, avoiding the cohomology imports of Modules.AffineHom.

proof_origin.place: Original step 3, proved directly by tensor induction and affine pullback extensionality. The square is abstract to prevent repeated reduction of concrete chart objects; no timeout is changed.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_chart_tensor_coordinate_recovery
    {A B C : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    (r : A →+* B) (r₁ : B →+* C) (r₀ : A →+* C)
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) (p : Z ⟶ Y) (q₀ : Z ⟶ X)
    (w : p ≫ q = q₀) (U : X.OpenCover.{u}) (a : U.I₀)
    (M N : (U.X a).Modules) (hMq : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (P Q : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (δM : P ≃ Γ(M, ⊤)) (δN : Q ≃ Γ(N, ⊤))
    (ρ₀ : C →+* Γ((U.pullback₁ q₀).X a, ⊤))
    (ρₓ : B →+* Γ((U.pullback₁ q).X a, ⊤))
    (e₀M : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj P ≃+
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj M, ⊤))
    (e₀N : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj Q ≃+
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj N, ⊤))
    (eₓM : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj P ≃+
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj M, ⊤))
    (eₓN : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj Q ≃+
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj N, ⊤))
    (h₀N : ∀ b z, e₀N (b • z) = ρ₀ b • e₀N z)
    (hₓM : ∀ b z, eₓM (b • z) = ρₓ b • eₓM z)
    (hₓN : ∀ b z, eₓN (b • z) = ρₓ b • eₓN z)
    (n₀M : ∀ m, e₀M ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[A,r₀] m) =
      pullbackΓ (U.pullbackHom q₀ a) M (δM m))
    (n₀N : ∀ m, e₀N ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[A,r₀] m) =
      pullbackΓ (U.pullbackHom q₀ a) N (δN m))
    (nₓM : ∀ m, eₓM ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A,r] m) =
      pullbackΓ (U.pullbackHom q a) M (δM m))
    (nₓN : ∀ m, eₓN ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A,r] m) =
      pullbackΓ (U.pullbackHom q a) N (δN m))
    (hAffine : IsAffine ((U.pullback₁ q).X a))
    (cQ : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj Q ≅
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₁).obj ((ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj Q))
    (hcQ : ∀ m, cQ.hom ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[A,r₀] m) =
      (1 : C) ⊗ₜ[B,r₁] ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A,r] m))
    (τ : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj P ⟶ (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj Q)
    (s : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj P ⟶ (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj Q)
    (hτ : ∀ m, τ ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[A,r₀] m) =
      cQ.inv ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[B,r₁] s ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A,r] m)))
    (ψ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj N)
    (s' : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj N)
    (hψ : ∀ z, ψ.app ⊤ (e₀M z) = e₀N (τ z))
    (hs : ∀ z, s'.app ⊤ (eₓM z) = eₓN (s z)) :
    let Uk : Y.OpenCover.{u} := U.pullback₁ q
    let V : Z.OpenCover.{u} := Uk.pullback₁ p
    let v : V.X a ⟶ (U.pullback₁ q₀).X a := pullback.lift (V.f a)
      (Uk.pullbackHom p a ≫ U.pullbackHom q a)
      (by
        dsimp only [V]
        rw [Category.assoc, U.pullbackHom_map,
          ← Category.assoc, Uk.pullbackHom_map, Category.assoc, w])
    (∀ b, v.appTop (ρ₀ (r₁ b)) = (Uk.pullbackHom p a).appTop (ρₓ b)) →
      chartOrdinaryMapRecovery q p q₀ w U a M N ψ s'
